title: ChatTurnRecord v1 (L10 chat corpus)
description: Immutable per-turn archive record for the tenant chat corpus (plan 0011 / epic lp-gkh). Captured at the platform boundary after a user input and agent output are known. One S3 object per turn_id. Not for UI hydrate (BFF remains temporary cache).

schema_version.description: ChatTurnRecord schema major. Required. Bump only with breaking shape changes; store under chat-corpus/v1/ prefix for this major.

record_type.description: Discriminator for multi-type corpus objects (v1 only defines chat_turn).

tenant_id.description: Tenant partition key (UUID string in Portal). S3 prefix uses this id; not a per-user root.

user_id.description: Authenticated end-user who initiated the turn. Metadata for filtering; not an S3 partition root.

instance_id.description: Agent/sandbox instance id that handled the turn (control-plane instance registry).

turn_id.description: Stable unique id for this request/response pair. Used as S3 object key component for idempotent PUT.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the turn completed (corpus write time / outbound known). Prefer UTC.

completed_at.description: Optional RFC3339 when assistant output finished; may equal created_at.

tool_events.description: Structured tool call lifecycle events observed during the turn (may be empty).

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest (no sha256: prefix).

modelRef.description: Model that produced the assistant output when known.

provider.description: Provider / router id (e.g. poolside, openai, litellm slot name).

api_id.description: Optional provider-native model id when distinct from display name.

turnMessageInput.description: User (or system-injected) turn input body with integrity hash.

role.description: Input role. Primary path is user; system allowed for scheduled/job-driven turns.

content.description: Full input text as delivered to the agent. Empty string allowed only for non-text attachments-only turns when content_sha256 still covers the empty UTF-8 body.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of content (lowercase hex). Required for integrity / idempotent equality.

turnMessageOutput.description: Assistant turn output body with integrity hash.

content.description: Full assistant text as delivered to the client (post tool loop).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of content (lowercase hex).

finish_reason.description: Model/provider finish reason when known (e.g. stop, length, tool_calls, error, cancelled).

toolEvent.description: One tool invocation phase archived with the turn (prefer final status; intermediate phases optional).

tool_call_id.description: Stable tool call id within the turn.

tool_name.description: Tool function name (e.g. read_file, bash, web_search).

target.description: Optional path/URL/query target of the tool.

duration_ms.description: Wall time for the tool call when known.

result_summary.description: Optional truncated/redacted result body for training/debug. Writers may omit large blobs.

error_message.description: Error detail when status is error.

turnMeta.description: Non-body operational metadata. additionalProperties allowed for forward-compatible writer tags.

duration_ms.description: End-to-end turn duration from user message accept to assistant delivery.

job_id.description: Scheduled-task / job id when the turn was job-driven.
